title: The Vow of the Crescent Cove
author: Wren Underhill
blurb: Dominic Quintana, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
